author: Amanda Brennan
title: 'When one pizza oven closes, another one opens': Strange Slice coming to CU - NewsBreak
text:
By Amanda Brennan Molly Sweeney ,
5 hours ago
CHAMPAIGN COUNTY, Ill. (WCIA) -- What was once a staple on the University of Illinois campus is coming back... sort of. Former Manolo’s employees are creating a new restaurant under a new name.
In October, WCIA reported the popular pizza and empanada restaurant closed its doors following a change in property ownership. Now, two staff members are opening their own business.
"When one pizza oven closes, another one opens. Manolo's closing and losing that spot…we want to keep the pizza coming around to Urbana because so many people want that pizza shaped hole in their heart," Gage Reed said.
Kyle’s Corner in Savoy closing its doors Cierra and Gage Reed are siblings from Oakwood. They said "Strange Slice" will offer New York-style pizza. They plan to cook each pie by hand, freeze it at its peak and then deliver it straight to your door (whether that be in Champaign, Urbana or Savoy).
"The way we're starting out, we are going to be doing a limited menu. Just cheese, pepperoni and the Strange Slice. They're all going to be partially cooked in the kitchen, then we will saran wrap them and freeze them. That way, people can place their orders on Monday and Tuesday, that gives us a week to make it, and that following Sunday they'll be out for delivery," Gage said.
Cierra said the duo hopes to create a space where people can "let their weirdness shine."
"Some people like weird toppings, and that's okay, because pizza is art. So if it makes you happy and your yummy is full, that's all that matters," Cierra said. "Embrace your weirdness. Never be scared of it. Strange Slice will always be a place for your weirdness to blossom and flourish."
They are planning to begin pizza deliveries in about two months, and hope to open a dine-in restaurant sometime in the future. You can find more information about Strange Slice -- including their website and how to sign up for their newsletter -- here . You can find their GoFundMe here .
